text:
Anya K.: Quick sync — scheduling a design review for the new /generate API + SDK ergonomics + Console UX. Thinking 60m so we can walk the RFC and mockups. Who's available next week?

Matt S.: I can do Tue/Wed mornings (PST). Can we keep it 60m if we want to do a live demo and Q&A?

Jia L.: Tue morning works for me. I can own the SDK pre-read (summary + sample snippet). I’ll post a short checklist and a small example repo link.

Samir R.: Wed afternoon (UTC) is better for design folks. I’ll own Console UX pre-read + upload Figma links. Also want to add "rollout feature flags" to the agenda.

Olivia P.: Heads up I'm on APAC hours next week — mornings PST are tough. Could we do lunch (PST) or record the session? :wave:

Keegan: If the main goal is API contract + SDK surface, could we split into 45m API/SDK + separate 30m Console follow-up? saves folks time.

Anya K.: Good feedback. Proposed plan: 1) 45m core review (RFC + SDK demos) 2) 30m optional Console deep-dive. I'll try for Tue 16:00 UTC (Tue 08:00 PST) or Wed 17:00 UTC. Which is better?

Matt S.: Tue 16:00 UTC is fine for me.

Jia L.: Tue works. I’ll post SDK pre-read by EOD Mon with: 
- short TL;DR of changes
- code sample (node + py)
- migration notes (breaking? deprecations?)
- tests to run locally

Samir R.: If you post the Figma + a 3-slide summary I'll do Console notes. I'll also add a checklist template.

Anya K.: Pre-read/checklist (draft) — please copy/edit: 
```
Pre-read checklist (for reviewers)
- Read RFC doc (link) — note any backward-compat concerns
- Run SDK sample locally (instructions + expected output)
- Validate console mockups in Figma (link) for edge states
- Flag rollout risks (feature flags, telemetry changes)
- Owners for follow-ups (API, SDK, Console, QA)
```

Olivia P.: If we go Tue 16:00 UTC, I can watch the recording + add comments asynchronously. Please add a recorded PR walkthrough for the SDK sample.

Keegan: +1 to that checklist. Also suggest adding a quick perf/latency note for /generate changes (especially if batching changes).

Anya K.: Great. Action items: 
- Jia: SDK pre-read + sample (due Mon EOD)
- Samir: Console summary + Figma (Mon EOD)
- Matt: I'll ping infra for a short perf note (Mon)
- Olivia: will review recording + comments

Anya K.: I'll put a calendar invite for Tue 16:00 UTC (45m core + optional 30m follow-up). If majority can't make Tue I'll switch to Wed. Tagging people here: @Matt S. @Jia L. @Samir R. @Olivia P. @Keegan :thumbsup:
